issue: No date validation for invalid experience periods
actual: Set experience end date (2020-01) earlier than start date (2021-03), and separately set start date to a future month (2027-01); in both cases no error message, alert, or aria-invalid state appeared anywhere on the page, and the invalid values were silently accepted into the field.
evidence: Queried [role=alert], .error, [aria-invalid=true] after entering invalid dates - no matching elements found besides unrelated buttons.

Date inputs use native type=month controls consistently for both start/end. Preview renders as 'Mar 2021 - Jun 2023'. Checking 'I currently work here' cleared and disabled the End Date field and preview showed 'Present'.

Clicking 'New Resume' created an 'Untitled Resume' with empty Contact, Summary, Experience, Education fields (all showed only placeholders / 'no items' state) and the editor was immediately interactive.

Entered/edited contact fields and summary; added two experience entries, edited fields, reordered via up/down arrows (order changed in editor and preview), added a third entry and deleted it successfully; added an education entry with edit; added/edited (level change)/removed skills successfully with live preview updates each time.
Every field edit (contact info, summary, experience, education, skills, reordering, current-position checkbox) was reflected in the Live Preview panel immediately without any save/refresh action.

Switched between Modern, Classic, and Minimal templates via the Template tab; the Live Preview layout/styling changed distinctly for each style while all contact, summary, experience, education, and skills content remained intact.
Renamed 'Work Experience' heading to 'Career History' in Sections tab; preview showed 'Career History' consistently across Modern, Classic, and Minimal styles.

In Sections tab, moved Education section above Career History via up-arrow (preview order updated), and toggled Skills section visibility off (Skills disappeared from preview) then back on (reappeared).
Section reorder and visibility toggle changes were reflected in the Live Preview immediately without navigation or refresh.

Clicked 'Hide Preview' - preview panel disappeared and button changed to 'Show Preview'. Clicked 'Show Preview' - preview reappeared with all editor content (contact, summary, experience, education, skills) and the Modern template intact.

issue: No validation feedback when renaming to empty/whitespace title
actual: Clearing the resume title to whitespace-only and pressing Enter silently reverted the title back to 'Untitled Resume' (the previous title was preserved, which is correct), but no error message, toast notification, or any other validation feedback was shown to the user. Checked for [role=alert], .text-red-500, .text-destructive, [class*=error] elements and body text for 'cannot'/'required'/'empty' - none found.

evidence: Renamed resume from 'Untitled Resume' to 'Senior Engineer Resume - TechCorp App'; the new title appeared in the editor header immediately, and after returning to dashboard the same title is shown on its card.
After navigating between tabs, returning to dashboard, and reopening the resume, all contact details, summary, experience, education, and skills content remained exactly as entered.

Edits (rename, content, template, section order/heading) were retained automatically without an explicit save; returning to dashboard showed updated title and date, and reopening the resume showed all changes intact.

Added many experience entries to force overflow of the preview area. Content grows beyond viewport height (docHeight 6458px vs innerHeight 720px) with visible overflow, and page-level scroll (window.scrollTo to bottom) successfully revealed all subsequent sections (Education, Skills) after the Career History entries - all section headings (Professional Summary, Career History, Education, Skills) and content remained present and readable.

issue: Resume changes are not persisted across a page reload
actual: Renamed 'Software Engineer Resume' to 'Reload Persistence Test Title' (confirmed applied in editor header). Performed a full page reload (navigating to http://localhost:6005/). After reload, the resume reverted entirely to its original title 'Software Engineer Resume' and original 'Updated Jan 20, 2024' timestamp - the rename was completely lost. Separately, a newly created resume ('Untitled Resume' renamed to 'Senior Engineer Resume - TechCorp App' with full contact/summary/experience/education/skills content) disappeared entirely from the dashboard after a page reload, confirming state is held only in-memory/session and not persisted to any storage (localStorage/backend) across reloads.
evidence: Before reload: editor header showed 'Reload Persistence Test Title'. After browser_navigate to http://localhost:6005/ (full reload): dashboard shows only the 3 original seed resumes with original titles/dates; the custom-created resume and the rename were both gone.

Duplicated 'Product Designer Resume' via card menu > Duplicate, which created 'Product Designer Resume (Copy)' with identical content and today's date (Aug 25, 2026). Renamed the copy to 'Jordan Rivera - Duplicate Test' and edited its Full Name field to 'Jordan Rivera EDITED COPY'. Returned to dashboard: both the renamed copy and the original 'Product Designer Resume' (Feb 25, 2024) appeared as separate cards. Opening the original confirmed its title and Full Name field ('Jordan Rivera') remained unchanged.

After duplicating 'Product Designer Resume' and editing the copy's title and Full Name field, the original resume's title and Full Name ('Jordan Rivera') remained unchanged when reopened - confirming edits to the duplicate did not propagate to the source, and vice versa (the source's original data was never affected by the copy's changes).

Created two new resumes in the same session: 'FT7 Variation Alpha' (Full Name 'Alpha Tester', Modern template) and 'FT7 Variation Beta' (Full Name 'Beta Tester', Classic template). Both appeared as separate, correctly distinguished cards on the dashboard with their respective template tags ('modern'/'classic') alongside all pre-existing and previously duplicated resumes, with no data cross-contamination between variations.

Searching lowercase 'marketing' correctly matched 'Marketing Manager Resume' (case-insensitive) and filtered out all other 5 resumes. Clearing the search box restored all 6 resumes. Switching sort dropdown to 'Oldest First' reordered cards ascending by date (Jan 20, 2024 -> Feb 10, 2024 -> Feb 25, 2024 -> Aug 25, 2026 items in creation order); switching back to 'Newest First' restored descending order. Dropdown also offers Title A-Z/Z-A options.

issue: No date filter feature exists on the dashboard
actual: Inspected the entire dashboard UI (search box, sort dropdown, and full DOM query for all inputs/buttons). Only a text 'Search resumes...' input and a 'Newest First' sort combobox (with Newest First/Oldest First/Title A-Z/Title Z-A options) are present. There is no date picker, date range selector, filter-by-date button, or any other control allowing users to filter saved resumes by exact creation date or a date range.
evidence: document.querySelectorAll('input') returned only one text input (Search resumes...); document.querySelectorAll('button') returned only 'New Resume' and 'Newest First' (sort trigger) - no date-filter related controls found anywhere on the page.
